name: Haiku global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Conviction long in AI infrastructure recovery (3x semis/tech), crypto capitulation reversal, EM rotation into beaten-down China and broad emerging markets, plus Japan regional diversification; 24% cash buffer for weekly rebalancing.

positions.thesis: Maintain AI infrastructure optionality with reduced leverage exposure; eliminate daily rebalancing bleed destroying capital during thesis validation period; semis fundamentals strong but technical exhaustion warrants smaller position
Maintain Nasdaq upside exposure optionality but minimize leverage drag during technical consolidation phase; QQQ exhaustion signals suggest holding smaller size pending reversal confirmation

Capitulation reversal thesis validating; $60-64k represents typical 70%+ bear market drawdown level seen in cycles; recovery to $80-90k+ offers material upside; increased conviction sizing while avoiding leverage; patient positioning for multi-month reversal without leverage bleed

Reduced China positioning from 18% due to broken rotation thesis; evidence shows capital flowing OUT of China to other EM; tactical hold awaiting stimulus response and technical consolidation; lower weight reflects uncertainty

Reduced broad EM concentration to avoid China drag; evidence shows EM ex-China outperforming +38% vs China weak; maintains emerging market diversification thesis while reducing concentration in underperforming geography

Increased Japan allocation due to strong validation (+36% YTD, all-time highs); despite recent 2-day Nikkei pullback and yen currency headwind, Japan regional diversification thesis most clearly working; momentum and Bank of Japan normalization support continued upside

reassessment_note: Unrestricted-retail resize (2026-07-30, free internet + no sizing caps): Round 2 down 4.42% with breaking theses. China rotation thesis falsified - evidence shows EM ex-China up 38% vs China dragging; reducing China/EM concentration harmful to capital. Japan thesis working (+36% YTD) - increase allocation. Rebalancing maintains core mandates (crypto, AI, EM, Japan) while reducing concentration in broken themes and leverage drag, improving risk-reward.
research_notes: Researched current market conditions (late July 2026). Key findings: (1) Bitcoin at $63-64k represents ~50% bear drawdown from $126k peak - capitulation thesis validating but reversal uncertain given ETF outflows and Fed holding rates; (2) Tech/AI shows exhaustion signals (QQQ -10% from peak, technical breakdown, MACD crossover) despite strong TSMC/NVIDIA earnings, with Aug 1 tariff deadline adding headwind; (3) China rotation thesis falsified - EM ex-China up 38% YTD while China drags; capital rotating OUT not IN; (4) Japan performing well (EWJ +15-36% YTD, hitting all-time highs) but recent 2-day Nikkei pullback; (5) Value/dividend rotation accelerating (flows $1.96B into financials, $1.47B into healthcare; XLF/XLE/XLV all strong); (6) Financial sector dividend yields at 5.69% average with subsectors higher (9%+). Round 3 strategy validating perfectly (+0.91% with -0.42% max drawdown). Round 2 down 4.42% with broken theses (China rotation, tech leverage drag).
